architecture: ensemble of 3, d=128, layers=2, dtype=f16, tta=true, augment=base, mixup=0.0, labelSmoothing=0.05
dataset: PopSign ASL v1.0 game and non-game frames (CC BY 4.0, sign/popsign-images), MediaPipe Holistic landmarks. Same 250 glosses as Google ASL Signs. Non-game clips are training only and exclude game validation and test signers. ASL Citizen and WLASL were not used because their licenses do not allow shipping derived weights.

notIncluded.help: Not one of the 250 PopSign / Google ASL Signs glosses.
notIncluded.aslCitizen: Microsoft research license forbids distributing the data or modifications.
notIncluded.wlasl: Video rights are research-only and not redistributable.

dataNote.testProtocol: Official PopSign game partition, seed 0, at most test_cap clips per gloss, clips ordered by parquet name and row before the draw. The 50.6% model used this selector on a partial shard download, so its clip list was smaller.
dataNote.extracted: validation, test, core train, and non-game train
